last_session.detail: They arrived at sunset. They assumed the treasure lay at one of the marked locations, but all the surrounding land was unknown to them.
last_session.text: The party arrived in Brandonsford at sunset, following a treasure map of places they did not recognize.

last_session.detail: Reginald said the Clurichen is a little trickster creature up to no good, and that wherever it goes they should stay away.
last_session.text: Reginald the frog warned Dr. Uriah that a trickster Clurichen comes into town from the riverbanks every night.

last_session.detail: Dunk split from the party to scavenge at the farm, preferring solitude to the inns. Gill says Sir Brandon got a magic sword from a fairy in the woods. With his friends, Brandon killed a dragon that had terrorized the town for weeks, and the town was named after him. They were knighted and then all left, and Brandon died. That dragon was dragged through town and ripped apart hundreds of years ago. Gill assumes the current dragon is a different one and does not know where dragons come from. Gill saw the current dragon, which wanted nothing to do with him, and he sent his three sons after it. Dunk asked to sleep in the barn and think over the offer. They drank from Gill's still while Gill shared gossip.
last_session.text: Dunk spent the night drinking with Farmer Gill, who told him the legend of Sir Brandon's dragon.

last_session.detail: Eric wants the dragon killed and its body dragged into town, and said it was the first of many problems he has. He passed on the account of George, a capable woodsman who lives nearby. George lost an arm to the dragon and described it as a black dragon, not a big one. When Eric defended George's account, Sir Phidipaldi slapped him with his glove and challenged him to a duel at dawn. The flustered Eric did not accept and only said Sir Phidipaldi was more skilled at adventure.
last_session.text: Eric the Reeve offered 1000 gold for the dragon. Sir Phidipaldi then slapped him with a glove and challenged him to a duel.

last_session.detail: Uriah brought the thief a Fox Tail Brew. Ned recognized Uriah as a Dagonite. Uriah said he was a scholar of folk remedies and lore looking for work with his crew. Ned asked 100 gold for the week. When Uriah asked about a night of at least ten kills, Ned kept the fee but offered back 5 gold per kill if he could do what he wanted with the victims.
last_session.text: Drop Dead Ned, a thief with a killer wasp, offered to work for Dr. Uriah, who said he would think about it.

last_session.detail: Quinn says his good stock is gone each morning, with half the glasses empty or knocked over, so he waters down what little he has. He believes Bentley steals it because Bentley's Fox Tail Brew is so popular. Quinn offered 100 gold for the help and proposed a fake shipment, which Sir Phidipaldi agreed to stage.
last_session.text: Sir Phidipaldi agreed to help Quinn catch whoever empties his good ale at the Golden Egg each night.

open.text: Find the treasure shown on the party's map.

open.detail: The party never explicitly accepted Eric's offer. Sir Phidipaldi said they would talk to the Reeve, then denied the dragon exists and challenged Eric to a duel.
open.text: Kill the black dragon and drag its body into Brandonsford to collect Eric the Reeve's 1000 gold.
Catch whoever empties Quinn's good ale at the Golden Egg each night and collect his 100 gold.

open.detail: Lady Hilda is a seasoned fighter in chain mail with a shield.
open.text: If the party pays Lady Hilda, she will join them to hunt the dragon. She won't go alone.

open.detail: Dr. Uriah said he would think about the offer.
open.text: If Dr. Uriah hires Drop Dead Ned for 100 gold a week, Ned and his killer wasp will do any job. Ned insists on killing people with the wasp.

open.detail: Quinn brings bottles, they fill them with water, and Sir Phidipaldi makes a big show of delivering ale to the Golden Egg.
open.text: If Sir Phidipaldi and Quinn stage their fake ale delivery, they may see who comes for the ale.
Where are the map's marked locations, and which one holds the treasure?

open.detail: Half the glasses are left empty or knocked over. Quinn believes Bentley is stealing it.
open.text: Who or what empties Quinn's good ale each night?
Where does the black dragon lurk outside Brandonsford?

open.detail: Bentley's restocking shipment is a week overdue, and nothing has come into Brandonsford in months.
open.text: What happened to Bentley's overdue shipment, and why has nothing arrived in months?

open.detail: Sir Brandon's dragon was killed centuries ago, and none has appeared since.
open.text: Where did this new dragon come from?
The black dragon tore off George's arm and may maim or kill others, including Gill's three sons hunting it now.
